ABOUT ME

Game UI/UX Designer | 2D Artist

I'm a Game UI/UX Designer and 2D Artist with over 9 years of experience in mobile and PC games. I've worked at ENIXAN Entertainment, Murka Games, and Burny Games, as well as at N-iX Games, where I contributed to projects for Wargaming, Netflix, and Paradox Interactive.

I work on both UX and visual design, from early concepts and prototypes to final game interfaces, icons, and artwork. My goal is to create interfaces that are easy to use, visually appealing, and fit the game's style.

I enjoy working closely with game designers, developers, and artists. I've also led design teams, mentored designers, and helped improve workflows to keep projects organized and maintain consistent quality.
